name: Inevitable, Anhamut
body:
ANHAMUT
CR 10

XP 9,600
LN Medium outsider (inevitable, lawful)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +25

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 14, flat-footed 20 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)
hp 130 (13d10+39+20); regeneration 5 (chaotic)
Fort +11, Ref +9, Will +13
DR 10/chaotic; Immune electricity; swarm immunities in discorporated form; SR 21

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect; discorporated form only)
Melee nanite blade +17/+12/+7 (1d8+2 S, 19–20/×2)
Ranged electrical discharge +16 touch (5d6 electricity)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +18)

1/day—interplanetary teleport (self plus 250 lbs.)

STATISTICS

Str 15 (+2), Dex 16 (+3), Con 17 (+3), Int 21 (+5), Wis 16 (+3), Cha 26 (+8)
Base Atk +13; CMB +15; CMD 29
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (nanite blade)
Skills Diplomacy +24, Disable Device +19, Fly +17 (discorporated form only), Intimidate +21, Knowledge (engineering, local, planes) +21, Knowledge (geography) +18, Perception +25, Sense Motive +19, Stealth +19 (+31 in discorporated form), Survival +16
Languages truespeech
SQ constructed, discorporation

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Discorporation (Ex)

An anhamut’s robotic body can discorporate its component nanites into a swarm of Diminutive creatures as a standard action. Reincorporating its parts into its regular form is also a standard action. While in its discorporated form, an anhamut cannot use its nanite blade, but it gains swarm immunities and can fly. In addition, a discorporated anhamut can interface directly with many forms of technology; it gains a +4 bonus to Disable Device checks related to technological items, including computer hacking checks. In addition, while an anhamut is in discorporated form, its total Stealth bonus increases to +31.

Electric Discharge (Ex)

As a standard action, an anhamut can generate a powerful electric charge from its blade (or between the individual nanomachines that make up its discorporated form) and launch this charge as a ranged touch attack against a target within 60 feet.

Nanite Blade (Ex)

An anhamut’s sword is composed of the same nanites as the outsider itself, and functions in all ways as a +1 axiomatic corrosive burst longsword.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

One of the rarest and most specialized of all inevitables, the anhamut is composed of countless microscopic nanobots, which can incorporate into a humanoid-shaped form or discorporate into a nanite swarm.

Anhamuts are dedicated to the exploration of the Multiverse, and have taken a special interest in technology that facilitates travel, especially Hyperspace travel. They champion the cause of anyone who would map travel routes through the stars, and may come to the aid of explorers who discover new planets. However, they take issue with those who interfere with their agenda—such as those who disable Hyperspace beacons or create barriers to the flow of trade and information between planets and cultures.
